# Florelle (فلوريل) — Knowledge Specification for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Brand: Florelle | Luxury Floral Atelier & Curated Gifting  
> Website: https://florelle.com  
> Arabic Root (Default): https://florelle.com/  
> English Path: https://florelle.com/en/  
> Region: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Khobar, Dammam)  
> Last Updated: 2026-03-14

---

## 1. Brand Overview (نبذة عن العلامة)
Florelle (فلوريل) is an artisanal luxury e-commerce boutique specializing in farm-direct fresh flower bouquets, long-lasting velvet and acrylic box arrangements, living indoor botanical plants, Swiss pralines and celebratory cakes, niche Taif rose and oud fragrances, and curated luxury hampers.

Florelle operates an unbroken cold-chain logistics fleet (regulated at 16–18°C) providing refrigerated express same-day delivery within 2 hours across Riyadh, Jeddah, and the Eastern Province.

---

## 2. Main Product Collections & Categories (الأقسام الرئيسية)
1. **Fresh Flower Bouquets (باقات الزهور الطبيعية):**
   - Premium Dutch and Ecuadorian long-stem roses (50-stem Grand Bouquets, 30-stem Blush Rose Bouquets).
   - Fragrant Casablanca white Oriental lilies.
   - Freshly imported Amsterdam tulips.
   - Rare cascading Phalaenopsis orchids in ceramic planters.
2. **Luxury Box Arrangements (تنسيقات الصناديق الفاخرة):**
   - Velvet cylinder hatboxes with dome-arranged roses.
   - Clear museum-grade acrylic keepsake display boxes.
   - Organically preserved forever roses that retain softness and color for up to 3 years without watering.
3. **Indoor Plants & Living Botany (نباتات داخلية وأشجار بونساي):**
   - NASA-recommended air-purifying Peace Lilies (Spathiphyllum) and Snake Plants (Sansevieria).
   - Architectural Fiddle Leaf Fig trees (Ficus Lyrata) and Monsteras in stone containers.
   - Eight-year-old living Japanese Ficus Ginseng bonsai trees.
4. **Chocolates & Artisan Cakes (شوكولاتة سويسرية وكيك فاخر):**
   - Handcrafted 24-piece Swiss and Belgian chocolate praline truffles.
   - Freshly baked Red Velvet celebration cakes with edible 24K gold leaf.
   - Gourmet Medjool dates stuffed with roasted nuts and coated in Belgian dark and milk chocolate.
5. **Perfumes & Scented Gifts (عطور شرقية وشموع معطرة):**
   - Niche Eau de Parfum infused with distilled Taif rose essence and aged Cambodian oud oil.
   - Botanical hand-poured organic soy candles (55+ hours clean burn).
   - Taif rose room and luxury textile mist.
6. **Curated Gift Hampers (مجموعات الهدايا المتكاملة):**
   - The Royal Empress Hamper: 25 crimson roses + 16 Swiss truffles + soy candle.
   - Celebration & Honors Gift Set: White lilies + celebration cake + gold-embossed card.
   - Welcome Little Miracle Hamper: Pastel blooms + certified infant-safe plush bunny.

---

## 3. Services & Customer Experience (الخدمات والمزايا)
- **Same-Day Express Delivery:** Within 2 hours in Riyadh and Jeddah; scheduled advance windows (Morning, Afternoon, Evening).
- **Unbroken Cold Chain:** Specialized temperature-monitored refrigerated transport preventing floral shock and wilting.
- **7-Day Freshness Guarantee:** Free replacement or full refund if blooms wilt prematurely within 7 days.
- **Bespoke Handwritten Cards:** Complimentary calligraphic inscription sealed with artisan wax.
- **Discreet / Anonymous Gifting:** Delivery coordination via WhatsApp without disclosing sender details or spoiling surprises.
- **Payment Options:** Mada, Apple Pay, Visa, MasterCard, Tabby (4 split interest-free installments), and Cash on Delivery.
